title: staged-continuity-migration-with-user-stickiness-and-fail-fast-rollback
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Introduces a Staged Continuity Migration controller that enables session-affinity-aware incremental model swaps, in-flight draining, and an SLO-aware fail-fast rollback policy. Backwards compatible configuration flags added to rollout API.
description: Motivation: Large incremental model swaps cause user-visible discontinuities when sessions or long-lived interactions are switched mid-flight to a new model variant. This PR introduces a Staged Continuity Migration controller and new rollout config primitives to preserve user stickiness, drain in-flight state gracefully, and trigger automated fail-fast rollback when SLO regressions appear. Goals: 1) Maintain session-level continuity for sticky keys (conversation_id, user_id) during phased rollouts. 2) Provide a configurable handoff window and drain policy to avoid mid-session semantic regressions. 3) Surface metrics and tracing for continuity, and introduce an SLO-aware backoff that can automatically abort/rollback a stage on quality/latency regression. 4) Keep the change opt-in and backward compatible with existing rollout specs. Summary of changes: - API: api/v1/rollout_types.go: added StagedContinuityStrategy struct with fields sessionAffinityKey (string), sticky_ttl_seconds (int), handoff_grace_ms (int), fail_fast_threshold_percent (float), safety_sampling_rate (float). The new fields are optional and validated during admission. - Controller: pkg/controller/rollout/staged_continuity_controller.go: new controller implementing a deterministic state machine: PREPARE -> MIRROR_SAMPLING -> STAGED_SWAP -> DRAIN -> VERIFY -> COMMIT/ROLLBACK. The controller uses workload-aware sampling (safety_sampling_rate) to mirror traffic into the candidate model during MIRROR_SAMPLING and collects prefix-level evals. - Routing: pkg/serve/router/sticky_router.go: sticky routing layer that maintains an ephemeral affinity map (sharded, bounded) keyed by sessionAffinityKey with TTL semantics. This router is used by staged rollouts to ensure subsequent requests from the same affinity key continue hitting the same model variant during the handoff window. - KV cache/Runtime: runtime/drain/connection_drain.go & runtime/kvcache/affinity_checkpoint.go: drain helpers that flush model-specific KV caches during DRAIN and optionally checkpoint affinity bindings so replays land consistently. - Observability: telemetry/metrics/rollout_continuity.go and tracing hooks in MIRROR_SAMPLING; added metrics: rollout_continuity_sticky_hits, rollout_continuity_switches, rollout_continuity_drain_duration_ms, rollout_continuity_fail_fast_triggers. - Safety: safety/failfast/oracle.go: statistical check that computes rolling percentile deltas for latency and quality (user-defined eval metrics) and triggers backoff when fail_fast_threshold_percent exceeded with minimum sample size. - Tests: tests/integration/staged_migration_test.go (integration harness that simulates long-lived conversations), tests/e2e/staged_migration_chaos_test.go (failure-injection to validate rollback), unit tests for router and controller. - Docs & examples: docs/rollouts/staged-continuity.md, examples/rollouts/staged_continuity_example.yaml. - Migration: upgrade job scripts in build/upgrade/rollout_migration_admit.sh to validate existing rollout specs; feature gate rollout.stagedContinuity.v1 (off by default). Design notes & rationale: - We intentionally keep affinity ephemeral and bounded to avoid state blowup; affinity entries are sharded in-memory with optional K/V checkpointing for long-running sessions. - The handoff_grace_ms lets operators specify a period during which requests are pinned to their prior model to reduce semantic jumps; after the window, the sticky router will allow rebalancing. - MIRROR_SAMPLING phase is used to collect quality signals without impacting production traffic; sampling rate is small by default (1%). - Fail-fast policy is conservative: it requires both statistical significance and a minimum sample volume before triggering a rollback. Implementation details: - Controller uses per-stage compact checkpoints stored in Namespace-scoped ConfigMaps to allow reconciliation after controller restarts. - Mirror traffic is sent to the candidate model via non-blocking forked requests; responses are compared asynchronously and stored in an ephemeral evaluation buffer. - For private deployments we fall back to local KMS-backed affinity checkpointing if object storage isn't available. Backwards compatibility & opt-in: - No existing rollout behavior changes unless the new strategy is added to a rollout spec. - Default feature gate is disabled; cluster admins must enable rollout.stagedContinuity.v1. Tests & verification: - Local unit tests added (pkg/controller/*_test.go). - Integration harness simulates 50k conversation steps over 1000 synthetic users to validate sticky behavior and drain windows. - E2E chaos test flips node pools and verifies controller state recovery and rollback. CI & checks: - Running: build (pass), unit tests (pass), integration (flaky on first run - one rerun required), lint (pass), doccheck (pass). - Final CI status: pass. Rollout plan & migration: - Feature gate rollout.stagedContinuity.v1 controlled rollout (platform operator opt-in). - Example manifests added for staged migration with recommended defaults: sticky_ttl_seconds=3600, handoff_grace_ms=5000, safety_sampling_rate=0.01, fail_fast_threshold_percent=8.0. - Operators should test in staging with MIRROR_SAMPLING before enabling STAGED_SWAP. Security review: - No new elevated permissions; controller uses existing RBAC scopes and ConfigMap read/write. - Affinity checkpointing uses envelope encryption when persisted. Performance notes: - Sticky routing adds a small lookup (~300ns) and a bounded memory footprint controlled by sticky_ttl_seconds and shard count. - Mirror sampling introduces additional CPU/IO proportional to safety_sampling_rate; default remains 1%. Checklist: - [x] API types and admission validation - [x] Controller implementation and retries - [x] Routing sticky layer and drain helpers - [x] Observability metrics and tracing hooks - [x] Integration and e2e tests - [x] Docs and example manifests - [x] Upgrade/migration scripts - [x] Security and perf notes Related: ENG-1739 (design doc), PM-481 (product acceptance criteria), SUP-7142 (support case motivating handoff window).

review_comments: Marco Li (reviewer): This looks solid. Please add a metric to track 'affinity_evictions' and ensure the shard count is configurable via configmap.
Author (Aisha): Added affinity_evictions metric and a cluster-level default shard count with override in rollout spec. See commit ff12e34.

Sofia Ramos (reviewer): Concern: MIRROR_SAMPLING might create data-exfil risks in private deployments if responses are logged. Need an opt-out for telemetry payloads and ensure mirror traffic respects PII redaction rules.
Author (Aisha): Added mirror redaction switch and ensured mirror payloads go to ephemeral in-cluster buffer encrypted at rest; documented in security section.
Evan Chen (reviewer): Suggest making fail_fast_threshold_percent a per-stage override. Otherwise approved.
Author (Aisha): Made threshold per-stage with cluster-default fallback; updated API docs and admission validation.
summary: Adds an opt-in staged continuity migration controller to preserve session affinity during model rollouts, with mirror sampling, drain semantics, and SLO-aware fail-fast rollback. Backward compatible; gated behind rollout.stagedContinuity.v1 feature flag.
